answer_1.quote: We propose an Embedding Reward Auto-Encoder (ER-AE) to generate differentially private text... The model can keep the generated text a close semantic and sentiment similarity to the original while providing a guarantee that one can hardly recover the original author's identity.
answer_1.outputs: differentially private text in natural language

answer_2.quote: We measure the degree of semantic preservation using the cosine similarity between the latent vector of the original text and the generated text based on the Universal Sentence Embedding (USE) model... The feature vector change is measured by the difference in L2 norm.
automatic_metrics: L2 norm of feature vector change
